answer:
Based on my research, I can now answer your question.

**The Bill:** The legislation you're referring to is the **Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act**, which was passed in July 2010. This act contains the "Volcker Rule" (Section 619), which gives federal banking agencies discretion to prohibit proprietary trading by certain financial institutions.

**The Majority Party:** The Dodd-Frank Act was passed by the **Democratic Party**, which held the majority in the 111th Congress.

**When Democrats Gained Control of the House:** Democrats gained control of the U.S. House of Representatives following the **November 4, 2008 elections**. They officially took office when the 111th Congress convened on **January 3, 2009**.

This was a significant gain for the Democratic Party, as they increased their majority in the House and maintained it throughout the 111th Congress (2009-2011), during which the Dodd-Frank Act was signed into law by President Barack Obama on July 21, 2010.
